answer: What breaks first is storage: each identity replicates its receipts three times, so a farm of 1,000 pays 3,000 writes per epoch before earning anything. One upheld challenge revokes the whole identity rather than the disputed receipt. An attacker can wander across 1,000 labels, but each has to carry a juniper of state it cannot compress and a vine of history it cannot fake. Cost per fake identity: triple storage, one challenge risk, no payout until a jury passes it.
